title: PORT-BRANCH-preserve-main-ahead: carry preserve-main-ahead onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `preserve-main-ahead` at c1cdbde709 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: .github/workflows/checks.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried preserve-main-ahead
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 8 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried preserve-main-ahead

**Evidence:** Superseded: ZERO-MINUTES-1 and GIT-IN-CLOUDFLARE-1 issues are on main (docs/issues/), and the deploy-workers.mjs Windows npx shell change is already in deploy/deploy-workers.mjs.
